user.title: Connect to the HDMI matrix
user.description: Enter the IP address and TCP control port of your MT-ViKI HDMI matrix switcher.

data_description.host: Give the switch a fixed address (DHCP reservation) so it does not change.
data_description.port: The switch listens on TCP port 8080 by default.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an MT-ViKI matrix at that address and port. Check the IP, the port, and that nothing else is holding the switch's control connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.

init.title: Input and output names
init.description: Names are used for the output selectors, the buttons, and the matrix card.

error.duplicate_input_names: Each input needs a different name.
error.reserved_input_name: "None" is reserved for "no signal"; choose another input name.

command_failed.message: The HDMI matrix did not accept the command: {error}

invalid_option.message: "{option}" is not an input on this matrix.
